releaseNotes: Bao mat: bat doi mat khau mac dinh, tam khoa khi do mat khau, siet phan quyen tai khoan don vi. So lieu thong nhat: mot cach tinh van ban da nop du cho moi man hinh, khong con doan (muc chua co danh muc hien ro). AUN-QA: giao, nop, duyet duoc van ban trong danh muc chung cua Tieu chuan; ma minh chung theo ma tieu chi.
